help.title: Help
help.known: Known: You remembered the card, it moves to the next learning step
help.difficult: Difficult: You barely remembered the card, it stays at the same learning step
help.almost: Almost: You forgot the card but were close to the answer, it goes back to the previous step
help.forgottenSoft: Forgotten: You forgot the card, it goes back to the previous step because you didn't enable the option to return to the first step when forgetting (in settings)
help.forgottenHard: Forgotten: You forgot the card, it returns to the first step because you enabled the option to return to the first step when forgetting (in settings)
help.forgotten: Forgotten: You forgot the card, it returns to the first step

deck.title: Deck
deck.name: Deck name
deck.noCards: This deck contains no cards. Click the + button to add some!
deck.emptyNameError: The deck name cannot be empty
deck.existingNameError: A deck already has this name
deck.learningResetted: Learning reset for the entire deck
deck.followDeckOnAlternate: to follow the deck's alternate setting
deck.alternateSidesExplanation: If this option is enabled, a card will alternate between showing the front and back during reviews. When a card is forgotten, the side does not change—the next review will show the side that was failed.
deck.alternateSidesExplanationForce: The button forces all cards in the deck to follow the deck's alternate setting.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hardThrowback: Go back to the first step when forgotten
settings.stopLearning: Stop learning after the last step
settings.hardThrowbackExplanation: If this setting is enabled, forgetting a card will reset it to the first learning step. If disabled, the card will only go back to the previous step. This setting has no effect when advanced review mode is enabled.
settings.stopLearningExplanation: If this setting is enabled, any card that passes the final learning step will no longer need to be learned. If disabled, a card that passes the final step will remain at that step.
settings.advancedModeExplanation: Advanced review mode displays four buttons instead of two during card revision, allowing for more precise feedback on your knowledge of the card.
settings.resettingSettings: the settings and return to default

library.title: Library
library.noDeck: There are no decks here. Click the + button to add one!

revision.chooseCardsExplanation:
All: all cards

Number: choose a specific number of cards to review

Step: choose a learning step above or below which you want to review cards

Unknown: only cards not yet learned

Learned: only learned cards
revision.chooseSideExplanation:
Front: the front will always be shown first

Back: the back will always be shown first

State: the side shown first will be the one set for each card's next review

?: the side shown first is random for each card

welcome.title: Welcome to Flipo!
welcome.text: Create flashcards and let Flipo tell you when to review them!

library.title: Here’s your library
library.text: This is where you manage your decks and cards. Click the + button to add a deck.

newDeck.title: Create decks
newDeck.text: Choose the deck settings. You can also import a deck in JSON format (for Flipo exports) or CSV format.

deck.title: View your cards
deck.text: From a deck’s page, you can see all its cards. Their next review date is shown on the right. You can filter and search for cards. Click a card to edit it. Long-press to change its learning status.

card.title: Add cards
card.text: Click the + button to add cards. You can include an image on the front and back.

learning.title: Start learning!
learning.text: Once a card is added, it appears in the Learning tab. The 'Learned' button moves the card to review for tomorrow. The 'Review Again' button keeps it in the Learning tab. The 'Ignore' button marks the card as not to learn—it won’t appear in the Learning tab until you mark it for learning again (from the Library).

daily.title: Review every day!
daily.text: Go to the Daily Revisions tab each day to find all the cards you need to review. Simply indicate whether you remember the card or not. Flipo will calculate when to show it again.

flash.title: Flash review
flash.text: From the deck page, click the small lightning bolt to review the deck without affecting the review dates.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: In Settings, you can adjust the spacing days for each learning step. You can also enable additional options. Click the info buttons to understand what they do.

end.title: Enjoy using Flipo!
end.text: You can revisit this tutorial by clicking the question mark in Settings.
